title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover under load-shedding
author: Samir Patel
description: Context: Following a production incident on 2025-02-09 we observed the SLO enforcer incorrectly escalating regional failover when aggressive load-shedding and backoff hysteresis interacted under high concurrency. Root cause: a race in backoff timer initialization combined with an ordering bug in the regional failover decision path allowed a partially-initialized backoff state to be treated as expired, which triggered unnecessary failover and cascading shedding. This PR fixes two issues: (A) initialize backoff timers using an atomic/state-guarded codepath to prevent early expiry; (B) reorder the failover evaluation so local capacity and hysteresis thresholds are evaluated before regional escalation. Additional changes: tighten default hysteresis thresholds to reduce thrash, add metrics and traces for the decision path, add unit and integration tests that reproduce the incident pattern, and update the runbook. Testing: unit tests + integration pipeline with synthetic load profile, manual canary in us-west-2 for 2 hours, and metric regression checks; CI passed after one integration rerun. Rollout: staged canary -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on SLO delta > 0.5%. Linked work: ENG-8492 (investigation), ENG-8520 (telemetry follow-up).

discussion: Aisha Kumar (reviewer): Observed flakiness in integration test on first run; can we add a deterministic seed to the synthetic load generator?
Samir Patel (author): Added deterministic seed and a short jitter window; re-ran integration pipeline, reproduced failure locally and verified the fix prevents early expiry.

Evan Park (reviewer): Nit: move the metric tags to include region and shard_id so we can pivot quickly in grafana. Also please add a short-lived log line at decision time for the canary to help debugging.
Samir Patel (author): Added region/shard_id tags to metrics and a structured log entry guarded by debug flag; will remove debug flag after canary if no issues.
Jing Wei (reviewer): Can you describe the rollback criteria for the staged rollout in the PR description? We should also add a feature flag to revert the new ordering quickly.
Samir Patel (author): Updated description with rollback criteria (SLO delta > 0.5%) and added a runtime feature flag slo.enforcer.new_failover_order (default true) for quick revert.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering and regional failover under aggressive load-shedding. Fixes race condition in backoff initialization and ordering bug that caused unnecessary regional escalation and load-shedding thrash. Adds telem and runbook updates. Rollback available via runtime flag slo.enforcer.new_failover_order.
